## D14 — Required operational controls

### OP26-D14-O01

**Signal:** D14-O01: unauthorized target disclosure/mutation

**Threshold:** Any confirmed occurrence

**Owner:** Support security owner

**Response:** Stop affected projection/writer/export, contain scope, preserve audit and re-prove authorization before reactivation; do not disable ordinary qualified intake.

### OP26-D14-O02

**Signal:** D14-O02: duplicate/lost coverage or orphaned target

**Threshold:** Any confirmed invariant violation

**Owner:** Support domain owner

**Response:** Fence the affected command path, reconcile original source/coverage/home receipts, repair with appended evidence and verify no duplicate reply/review/score.

### OP26-D14-O03

**Signal:** D14-O03: due-review processing lag

**Threshold:** Oldest qualified due review exceeds 5 minutes while worker service should be active

**Owner:** Workflow/Support on-call

**Response:** Keep authorized due queries visible, inspect queue/claim failures and catch up current generations only; no new dates or repeated review.

### OP26-D14-O04

**Signal:** D14-O04: unknown acceptance/clock evidence

**Threshold:** Every new actionable root cause opens one grouped case

**Owner:** P6 delivery owner or Support calendar/source owner

**Response:** Reconcile exact proof; display timing unavailable/unknown and earliest candidate as applicable. Never infer met/missed or call the provider from the target module.

### OP26-D14-O05

**Signal:** D14-O05: report/projection reconciliation difference

**Threshold:** Any mismatched authorized count, membership or formula in scheduled verification

**Owner:** Support reporting owner

**Response:** Mark affected report stale/unavailable, fix projection against owner facts, preserve prior generated snapshots and re-prove shared predicates.

### OP26-D14-O06

**Signal:** D14-O06: timezone/calendar contract drift

**Threshold:** Any pinned golden-case failure or unsupported calendar/calculation generation

**Owner:** Shared calendar owner

**Response:** Stop new affected deadline calculations, keep known frozen deadlines/history, expose recovery and qualify corrected version before use.

### OP26-D14-O07

**Signal:** D14-O07: unbounded work/body-fetch regression

**Threshold:** Any target query/export that hydrates message bodies or bypasses the qualified page/budget contract

**Owner:** API/reporting owner

**Response:** Stop that query/export path, restore indexed summary access and run the production-shaped query-plan/load suite.

### OP26-D14-O08

**Signal:** D14-O08: misleading UX or historical credit

**Threshold:** Any reproduced false On track/success, reminder loss, hidden overdue work or assignment-as-responder attribution

**Owner:** Support product/design + domain owner

**Response:** Treat as a release blocker for the affected journey; correct projection/copy/behavior and rerun the corresponding P proof.

### OP26-D14-O09

**Signal:** D14-O09: post-migration seeded activation or replay

**Threshold:** Any target created from unqualified legacy/default/backfilled timing

**Owner:** Release owner

**Response:** Stop target creation in affected scope, preserve source work, mark false projections for auditable correction and qualify rollout before resuming.

### REQ26-D14-C010 — Operating and qualification sequence

**Capture in eventual specification/design in dependency order:** (1) qualified source/coverage/P6 acceptance contracts and original identity; (2) policy/calendar revision and temporal model; (3) atomic period/home/due-review/history commands; (4) authorized current/read/report projections; (5) small setup/detail/report UX; (6) additive activation, migration and recovery. Changing old fields first without these meanings would preserve the wrong behavior.

**Required implementation safeguards:** all-writer authorization and tenant constraints; exact coverage/duplicate/late-proof fences; bounded calendar arithmetic; immutable history with explicit correction; independent current due visibility; grouped repair; zero body hydration for target reports; full source-to-CRM journeys, concurrency, DST, roll-forward/rollback and accessibility proof. They are activation gates, not optional monitoring work.

**Monitor residual production behavior after those gates pass.** Thresholds below are explicit operational response policies, not measured current SLAs or donor promises. They never authorize changed provider retries, metric resets or permission expansion.

## D15 — Binding requirements

### REQ26-D15-R01 — Necessity, alternatives and domain scope

Provide optional ongoing staff interest in a particular Support conversation. The strongest smaller alternative is directed attention plus existing views/search; it requires more remembering or repeated mentions when a colleague wants the eventual outcome. Automatic following after participation saves one action but introduces implicit enrollment and extra stop rules. A is the chosen posture. No measured ministry demand, notification-volume improvement or satisfaction gain is claimed from vendor availability alone.

Keep following, direct mention, Support handling, delegated-work interest, email audience, CRM relevance and notification engagement distinct. D11's Stop following this work ends a conversation's interest in a delegated action; Stop following conversation ends one staff member's optional conversation updates. Neither substitutes for the other. No generic subscription platform, public follower feature, personal conversation status machine, customer-wide following, read-surveillance roster, AI relevance grader or management leaderboard is introduced.

### REQ26-D15-R02 — Personal identity and voluntary enrollment

Follow and personal channel changes derive the authenticated staff principal, active tenant, exact staff recipient/role authority and actor from trusted server context. Qualify the existing identity-owner mapping; matching an email, selecting the first Support agent or accepting caller-controlled agentId is not acting authority. A requester, message participant, CRM Party, authenticated user, Support worker and record owner remain distinct.

Only the person enrolls their own following. No automatic Follow on reply, note, mention, assignment, creation, viewing, import, CRM link or team membership. No colleague/admin Add follower control or cross-tenant preference is offered. Qualified privacy/access administration may end unsafe authority without impersonating a user's voluntary Stop. Tenant/role navigation changes visible context and cache scope; it does not itself terminate valid follows in another tenant. A genuine loss of the bound staff/source authority follows R05.

### REQ26-D15-R03 — Exact original-source scope

A normal Follow captures the currently reviewed, authorized original conversation source. On a merged view it captures the explicit currently reviewed source set, never every present or future source that may later resolve to that root. The server verifies submitted scope against its authorized projection and relevant topology revision; caller IDs cannot widen it. Existing active follows in that set retain their start/generation; only newly included sources receive new following generations.

Use personal per-original relationships and exact operation scope, not one mutable follower array on a root or a copied subscription graph. Current component projection may display one row for several original follows. Current access filters names, counts and scope choices before presentation. **Following selected threads** describes a partial disclosed scope; **Follow all current threads** deliberately includes the permitted reviewed set. Neither phrase claims knowledge of hidden originals or grants access. Newly merged sources never enroll by implication.

### REQ26-D15-R04 — Explicit commands and reliable outcomes

Commands express desired Follow/Stop state, a durable operation identity, expected personal generation and the exact relevant topology/authority scope. They are not blind toggles. Exact retry returns the recorded result; changed input or a stale opposite operation reconciles rather than reversing a newer decision. A delayed Stop cannot cancel a later explicit re-follow. A timed-out Follow is pending until its outcome is recovered; UI optimism is not authority.

Atomically sample the source activity admission frontier when starting each generation. Do not reject a safe Follow merely because an ordinary new message arrived before the click committed; that activity may correctly precede enrollment. Refresh is required for changed followed scope/topology or authority, not an unrelated composer collision. Stop affects only the reviewed current self-owned generations; a concurrent newly followed or newly merged source is not silently swept into it. A repeat desired state is a no-op with a truthful receipt, not another notification or history event.

### REQ26-D15-R05 — Stop, re-follow, access loss and ordinary endings

Follow persists across Open, both Waiting categories, ordinary Resolve, manual reassignment, coverage and inbox moves while exact source/staff authority remains valid. It is not a duty and does not need an active task. A later genuinely new permitted contribution can therefore update a follower of a resolved conversation. Following a currently resolved conversation is allowed and future-only; it does not replay its history.

Stop ends new optional selection and unsent authorization for those generations. It also ends unread treatment for already-available follow-only information through an explicit source-applicability correction, without inventing a read. Authorized recent history remains under its original P17 limits. Already-authorized in-flight/accepted email cannot be recalled. Stop never changes shared status, reminder, reply coverage, assignment, delegated work or a separately qualified direct/required attention reason. Re-follow starts a new generation/frontier and never restores old unread debt, canceled deliveries or stopped generations.

Confirmed loss of the relevant staff/source access, account retirement or source retirement closes only affected generations and removes active/recent presentation under ADR0027. Later regrant requires a new deliberate Follow and cannot transfer old role-scoped notices. An authorization outage or indeterminate identity lookup fails closed temporarily; it is not proof to permanently end intent. Stop remains available through a safe self-owned cleanup command without disclosing an inaccessible source. A source-scope erasure/correction applies the owning retention/privacy policy; it does not fabricate another request or user.

### REQ26-D15-R06 — Finite useful activity set

Only the following source-qualified classes create optional following information. Qualification uses actual original/affected source scope and immutable occurrence identity. Repeated webhook or projection writes are not new human activity.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Class | Included occurrence                                                                  | Required boundary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| E1    | A newly qualified human inbound contribution becomes Support-ready                   | Preserve original receipt time and first qualified admission separately. No quarantined/unqualified body, suspected automation, duplicate input, forwarded unrelated content or attachment-progress notice. Input that also reopens work creates one contribution update with truthful context.                 |
| E2    | A genuine human Support reply receives qualified P6 acceptance evidence              | Preserve actual original message/effect and qualified recipient/member meaning. Queued/draft/unknown/automatic mail cannot become a sent-human update. Show partial recipient evidence honestly. A transferred reply remains its native original; D14 coverage of another original is not follower inheritance. |
| E3    | A human internal note is published                                                   | Current permission for that exact note is required. A system summary, event row or scan is not human publication. Edits/redaction correct existing presentation under R08, without a new alert for every edit.                                                                                                  |
| E4    | A deliberate human work ending or reopening, including truthful D12 Continued ending | Describe Support's actual ending reason, not completion of a refund or other domain. Use the exact affected-source set for a component-wide action. Created-in-error retirement is correction/end-of-authority, not a new successful outcome notice.                                                            |

Routine assignment/coverage/inbox/Waiting/label/priority edits update current work views without an optional follower notice. D14 due Open, reminder/timer processing, delivery tracking, scans, retries, Follow/Stop, notification engagement and unrelated CRM/Party/task activity do not enter this set. Required custody, assistance, recovery or direct-mention attention remains governed by its own producer. A staff action with an explanatory note and work ending may form one qualified source episode while preserving its distinct facts; closeness in time alone is insufficient.

### REQ26-D15-R07 — Self-events and overlapping recipient reasons

Suppress only the optional FOLLOW reason when the event's trusted human author is the same staff recipient. Do not infer authorship from current assignment, matched email, task creator or background worker. A delayed acceptance of one's own reply remains visible through D4/P6 send status and recovery; following is not a second sender receipt system. Another person's input or a genuine owner result remains independently eligible even if the current handler is the recipient.

Several original follow contributions may select the same recipient for one genuinely common activity. Deduplicate the optional contribution set within the same meaning, privacy and channel binding. A root-wide E4 update remains eligible if any of its frozen, independently qualified source/follow contributions remains current; stopping A alone cannot erase a still-valid B contribution. Never add new C or a re-follow generation to that frozen set.

Where a direct/source-required recipient reason overlaps, omit duplicate optional delivery only under an explicit typed same-occurrence, same-recipient, same-channel purpose-equivalence rule. Preserve reason evidence. A disabled direct email does not suppress an otherwise allowed follower email merely because an in-product direct item exists. Distinct tasks, source episodes or contract meanings retain separate effects; do not merge them by recipient/time or group across P17's prohibited boundaries. No blanket one-event/one-item claim overrides the shared model.

### REQ26-D15-R08 — Admission time, late evidence and corrections

The source owner commits one first-qualified activity identity, exact source scope, authoritative admission frontier and identifier-only outbox obligation with the ordinary source write. Original email Date, provider receipt, worker run time and callback arrival are not interchangeable. A delayed first qualification may be a new available contribution; its actual original receipt remains visible. A repeat qualification/import/attachment callback cannot manufacture another occurrence.

At first successful notification admission, select only follow generations eligible at that source frontier which still have current applicable authority. Historical generations must survive the unresolved eligibility/recovery horizon. New followers or re-followed generations cannot join old events. After a complete occurrence is released, retries use recorded membership and pins, never a fresh follower query.

First-qualified source activity also fixes an immutable **source usefulness origin**, distinct from actual later P6 admission/local available_at. A delayed first notification must not start a new usefulness window. E2 late confirmation preserves the actual proven reply time and confirmation time separately; it must not claim the person sent a reply just now. The source origin is first qualified Support availability, not a forgeable email Date or each worker attempt. R09/R11 impose exact earlier source cutoffs while keeping actual local availability truthful.

An edited/redacted note, corrected false acceptance, mistaken source link or privacy change invalidates unsafe existing preview/destination/dispatch through its exact owner fence. Preserve body-free history and the correction cause. Do not hot-rewrite sent bytes or create another optional message merely to advertise routine editing. A superseded status occurrence loses stale unread treatment; a genuine immutable message update need not disappear merely because Support is now resolved. Material new source occurrences remain separately identifiable.

### REQ26-D15-R09 — Shared Information presentation and engagement

The eligible in-product step uses `prepared.none@1` and `presentation.information_30d_then_recent_90d@1`: **All** only; no Needs attention item merely because someone follows or has not read an update. It contributes at most its authorized unread group according to P17. Read/archive/source correction or 30 days ends unread treatment; ordinary authorized recent presentation ends at 90 days from the original available_at. Stop is the specified applicability correction; access loss removes active and recent presentation immediately. No fabricated read, renewed expiry or resurrected old item follows later authority.

Delivery requiredness after deliberate eligibility is distinct from business actionability: the source plan may require the in-product step for a valid following update without creating a required task or Attention/Urgent classification. Keep current work, following intent and notification engagement independent. Use P17's existing grouping only for a real common source episode and permitted contract/role/privacy meaning; repeated worker attempts cannot create badge debt. Delayed projection/recovery never resets an already-established availability clock. Expired current read predicates work even if purge is late.

The exact D15 source-end contract narrows, never extends, P17's existing policy. Unread ends at the earliest of actual available_at + 30 days, source usefulness origin + 30 days, read/archive or applicable unread correction. Presentability ends at the earliest of actual available_at + 90 days, source usefulness origin + 90 days, or applicable access/privacy/source-retirement boundaries. Ordinary read/archive and Stop's unread correction do not erase authorized recent history. A first projection at day 40 is history-only with no unread debt; at or beyond day 90 the optional occurrence is no longer presentable and no fresh item is minted. Actual P6 available_at is never backdated. This is a typed source-applicability narrowing using the same two platform policies, not a third policy or tenant duration matrix. Qualify the earlier source cutoffs in P17's binding/presentation proof before Live use. These 7/30/90-day source windows use elapsed 24-hour days and exact instants, not D14 service hours or the viewer's local calendar. Expiry applies at equality; locale/timezone changes affect display only.

### REQ26-D15-R10 — Complete occurrence release and independent member applicability

D1 intake commits recoverable source activity/outbox without scanning followers, preparing email or waiting for P6 fan-out. At the first notification admission, the generated shared binding derives the complete bounded eligible recipient/channel set and pins plan, contract, source/frontier and follow contributions; compile and release atomically, including a durable zero-member result. Before a successful committed admission, qualification may retry against the same historical frontier and current authority. After release, original result/membership is authoritative; later changes suppress existing members rather than recompile changed input under an occupied occurrence.

Preserve P6's all-before-any compiler. Do not call private child insertion directly, split one logical activity into separately released pages, or disguise its fan-out with per-follower occurrence identities. Membership count/digest, independently keyed member slots and same-scope parent relationships remain required.

**Explicit P6/P17 prerequisite amendment:** the existing documented plan request exposes a common source fence and does not establish the independent personal guard needed here. Qualify a closed generated binding that seals the immutable activity fence plus each member's exact admitted follow-contribution applicability references. Server-side dispatch linearization and presentation re-prove both. Stop advances/closes only affected personal applicability, not the common activity fence or unrelated siblings. For a member with several frozen eligible contributions, a closed owner-defined any-still-valid rule applies; no caller predicate, generic rule DSL or dynamic new membership. Include these references in semantic/immutable hashes, same-scope constraints, deterministic locking and old/new compatibility proof. Shared source erasure/correction can still invalidate all affected members. An N–1 dispatcher that lacks this guard must reject the new binding.

### REQ26-D15-R11 — Optional staff email and governed preferences

Offer a personal, tenant-scoped **Email updates for conversations I follow** setting in the existing shared notification preferences, default Off for this new meaning. Following itself does not turn it on, alter other topics or choose email recipients. The tenant's governed plan may disable the optional email step; user preference cannot override that or a current source/privacy stop. Explain effective channel availability without making Follow depend on email readiness. No duplicate Support-local preference matrix, first-agent fallback or editing colleagues' settings is permitted.

The in-product Information step works independently. Optional email uses the exact qualified staff account/Party/role contact authority, P17 preparation and P6/Resend dispatch; never requester addresses, donor preferred email or arbitrary fallback. Disabling this optional channel stops new/unstarted eligible email under its own fence without ending follows or in-product information. Re-enable applies to future occurrences, not an old email backlog. Do not infer an email step complete or suppress it solely because another channel was read; any future cross-channel suppression needs its own explicitly qualified contract.

Email eligibility must exist in the source-activity-bound personal and applicable tenant channel-enable generations **and** remain current at first admission and dispatch. Off→activity→On cannot create email eligibility for the old activity; On→activity→Off→On cannot resurrect the old channel generation. The email member seals these generated channel applicability guards as well as its Follow contributions; disabling email cannot close the in-product sibling or another recipient. Ordinary wording/plan edits retain P17's effective-plan rules; a true email enable/disable episode is separate from those edits.

The optional email's source utility ends seven days after the immutable source usefulness origin, or earlier on any applicable Stop/access/privacy/source/purpose fence. This is a chosen maximum for stale optional staff information, not a universal help-desk standard or delivery promise. At the cutoff, unstarted email truthfully expires while a still-valid in-product history/update can remain. Late compilation, preference re-enable, artifact sealing and retries cannot renew that utility. Preserve independent already-authorized/accepted/indeterminate provider facts and their P6 reconciliation limits.

**Explicit P17 amendment:** add the narrow closed class `prepared.optional_support_follow_update_7d@1` for this informational optional staff sibling. Preserve the old `prepared.optional_staff_7d@1` scope rather than silently broadening its immutable meaning or falsely labelling following as required action. The new class has a seven-day absolute ceiling after sealing, shortened by every source, utility, follow-generation, role/access, privacy or safety stop. Seven days is the chosen bounded staff-material ceiling, not an email retry window or promised delivery delay. Catalog/manifest generation and full owner conformance proof precede Live activation.

### REQ26-D15-R12 — Email Studio content and Resend evidence

Provide a canonical Email Studio starter **Followed conversation update**, using the existing staff/service-compatible presentation, protected purpose, published revision and safe allow-list in the companion blueprint. The default external email is a brief pointer, without transcript, note text, attachments, financial facts, missionary details, recipient list or sensitive subject. It directs staff into authenticated Support to read/respond. The template cannot choose recipients, set status, embed unrestricted CRM variables or add action authority.

Use qualified tenant staff-operation sender/reply identity and typed View conversation/Manage following destinations. GET, scanners and prefetch may open a landing page but never Follow/Stop, mark source work complete or execute an owner action. All changes require the ordinary authenticated explicit command; no tokenized public unsubscribe that changes Support state. No notification-email reply channel for publishing notes or replying to the requester is introduced.

P6 keeps one true notification communication occurrence and exact provider evidence; this is staff operational history, not donor correspondence or a second Support message. Pending/accepted/delivered/bounced/unknown remain distinct. Retrying uses the existing immutable intent/submission and Resend-qualified policy; expired provider idempotency is reconcile-only, not permission to resend or rekey. Recent sent copy, audit and prepared material keep their separate P17 classes and current privacy controls. Default pointer content does not authorize new provider-side templates or a second renderer/sender.

### REQ26-D15-R13 — Merge and Undo continuity

D10 topology changes preserve active/ended original follows and their frontiers. A pre-merge A follower does not receive B-only messages/notes/replies because B later joins the root. Following a currently merged A+B view can deliberately enroll both, and later C is still excluded. A newly published general note or reply retains its D10 actual original affinity. Whole-component human outcome events carry an exact affected-source receipt and select only intersecting existing follows.

Undo partitions current interest with originals and preserves later Stops/new Follows; it never restores a pre-merge follower snapshot, copies participants, creates a historical notification wall or changes shared ownership. An already-available update keeps its original source evidence; click resolves current permitted handling and the relevant source anchor. Old URLs are requalified, not permanent unguarded redirects. New topology changes cannot broaden existing frozen notification membership or rewrite prepared email. Missing access yields safe current navigation/error, not a leaked target name/count.

### REQ26-D15-R14 — Related conversations and delegated work

D12 creating a related or continued conversation carries no followers. A truthful Continued ending can update A's current followers; an authorized Open continued conversation link allows a new deliberate Follow there. Following A does not subscribe to B's later native replies, even when B fulfills a D14-transferred A obligation. Make that distinction clear at the continuation handoff rather than silently broadening interest.

D11 task/custody/result attention remains independently required under its exact source contracts. A colleague with only permission for a minimal delegated brief does not gain access to the full Support thread through Follow. Follow is available only when current source read authority exists. Stopping conversation updates never withdraws the task, ends the Support coordinator's interest in its result or suppresses current required recovery.

### REQ26-D15-R15 — Handling, role and identity changes

Becoming or ceasing to be the handler does not start/stop voluntary following. Shared Unassigned custody is not a follower or a fictitious P6 recipient. D6/D7/D8 routing, absence and access-loss duties retain their existing rules. A Follow cannot improve workload scores, substitute for coverage or claim that someone is watching the queue.

Auth/identity owns principal/Party/role continuity. Party merge, address change, relinking, account claim or cross-role navigation cannot transfer personal follows or old unread history to another principal. Current identity mapping, source permission and exact recipient context must be proved for every new projection. Only actual loss of the bound staff/source authority ends the affected generation; unrelated CRM field access changes do not automatically end a still-authorized ordinary Support follow. No matching-email recovery or copied CRM ownership is allowed.

### REQ26-D15-R16 — Database integrity and authoritative mutation

Support owns a small relational following model with one current relationship per tenant, original source and qualified staff authority scope; non-overlapping historical generations and at most one active generation. Non-null trusted tenant/principal/source/generation keys, same-tenant composite FKs, unique active relations, durable operation uniqueness, exact source-occurrence/member contribution uniqueness and valid start/end/control combinations prevent ambiguous state. Bound integer generations against overflow; use trusted UTC instants plus authoritative ordering, never Date or wall-clock equality as the only race fence.

No follower arrays, copied CRM email/name authority, money columns, mutable author fields or cascade deletion of necessary pending/history evidence. Define restrictive delete/retirement behavior and owner erasure/tombstone policy. Active rows may remain indefinitely by explicit interest; stopped history is minimized under R22, not an eternal content archive. Follow/control history and invalidating outbox/fence effects commit together. Source activity and its outbox obligation commit together. The later shared compiler atomically creates all recipient-step effects; source work is not rolled back for optional notification failure.

### REQ26-D15-R17 — Grants, RLS and every authorization path

Deny raw anonymous/authenticated enumeration and DML on protected follows, generations, recipient decisions, control and audit records. Use approved owner commands/current-authorized projections through the shared business API; browser approved collections do not become write authority. Keep RLS as defense in depth, with exact tenant/source/personal predicates. Any supported mutation policy must enforce old-row USING and resulting-row WITH CHECK, immutable subject fields and safe grants. A same-tenant FK alone cannot authorize another person's Follow.

Views/functions/RPCs, storage, exports, realtime, service-role jobs, repair tools and imports preserve the same boundaries. Security-definer/service credentials are not permission to skip the owner PDP. No self-relation mutation can transform a permitted record into another tenant/principal/original or forge a notification. Author, owner, role, source/follow generation and audit attribution derive from trusted owner context. Raw query errors must not enumerate hidden sources. Server auth lives at the actual route/command, not just a layout or picker.

### REQ26-D15-R18 — Complete personal queries, caches and current counts

The native Following filter queries current authorized active original follows, resolves current roots, then deduplicates before stable sorting/counting/pagination. One row is one current continuing conversation; underlying personal sources are available in permitted detail. Show All statuses initially so resolved follows remain findable, with explicit user filters thereafter. It is a personal finder, not another authoritative queue or unread counter.

Use **Latest followed update** for an activity sort tied to eligible followed-source facts; unrelated newly merged source activity must not silently bump that personal row. Counts, pages and search share the same pre-pagination authorization/membership predicates. Do not filter a capped 1,000/2,000-row client list or fetch message bodies to find follows. Index tenant/viewer/role active relationships, original/generation intervals, current topology resolution and occurrence/operation keys; batch PDP projection within proven budgets.

Cache identity includes active tenant, authenticated viewer/role and relevant source/access revisions. Tenant/role switch clears old visible state immediately. Realtime carries authorized invalidation identifiers, not bodies/follower rosters, and missed invalidations recover via cursors/current reads. A stale/offline view says so and revalidates on reconnect; stale client state never authorizes a command or restricted preview.

### REQ26-D15-R19 — Everyday control, partial following and corrections

Use the existing Core base-maia/Base UI components, semantic Zinc-family tokens and conversation action hierarchy. A compact Follow action becomes a clearly labelled Following control with Stop following conversation in the same place. Partial disclosed scope says Following selected threads and offers View followed threads / Follow all current threads through one bounded current-scope panel. No routine modal, follower-avatar row, manager roster or hover-only explanation.

Copy: **Get updates about this conversation. Assignment stays with Alex.** Use the current responsible inbox for Shared. Stop copy: **Stops optional updates for you. It does not change who handles the conversation or stop required attention.** Keep D11's similarly named action confined to its linked-work card. These helpers explain normal use; implementation/fence terms do not appear in ordinary product UI.

Pending/success/conflict/denied/network-unknown states show the real command result while preserving drafts, selection and focus. Stop has a persistent path; re-follow is labelled Follow again and starts future-only, not a misleading restore-everything Undo. In the Following view, support bounded **Stop following selected** through existing selection conventions and exact reviewed personal scope, with declared current-result handling and retry only unresolved/failed operations. No bulk Follow, Follow team, or all-tenant subscription is needed.

### REQ26-D15-R20 — CRM and cross-surface continuity

Opening Support from an authorized CRM record exposes the same personal Follow state/control and preserves return record, filters, scroll and private draft. Current Support-source and CRM permissions are independently enforced. Following creates no CRM Party, relationship, Activity item, last-contact change, donor email or access grant. Staff notification events remain operational P6 facts and do not duplicate the actual requester correspondence.

Typed destinations resolve the current permitted original/root and source anchor at click. Follow does not retrieve restricted giving/member-care/missionary context merely because the actor can see Support. Receipt/refund/recurring/contact actions still run in their owning domain with current validation, approval and audit. A notification read, voluntary interest or Support ending is never completion of that action. D1's requester email journey and absence of a new portal conversation archive remain unchanged.

### REQ26-D15-R21 — Accessibility, mobile and low-bandwidth behavior

Use native command/menu semantics and Base UI focus behavior. A changing Follow/Following/Stop action label must not pretend to be a stable-label aria-pressed toggle; if a toggle primitive is chosen, its accessible label/state contract must remain correct. Preserve visible focus, Enter/Space/menu keyboard operation, Escape and return focus, associated descriptions and polite material result announcements. Status meaning is text-based, not only color, icon, toast or hover.

At 320 CSS pixels and 200% zoom, the normal action and source-scope panel remain usable with long international names, RTL and localized dates. Use the existing mobile full-height detail/sheet instead of stacked drawers. A successful Stop may remove a Following row but must not strand keyboard focus or navigate away from an open draft. New updates do not reorder under the pointer or steal focus. No per-event sound/desktop-push campaign, ticking announcement or new animation system is introduced. Existing P17 preferences/presentation remain authoritative.

### REQ26-D15-R22 — Privacy, retention and audit minimization

Personal interest is protected metadata. Ordinary users see their own state; no default roster, follower count, staff read history, export of colleagues' interests or adoption leaderboard is needed. Purpose-authorized repair/security audit may inspect minimum body-free causal evidence. Record trusted actor, exact operation/source/generation, outcome/cause and parent/member references; logs and metrics omit bodies, email addresses, note snippets, private names and secrets.

Follow data does not copy conversation bodies or attachments. Retain original generation intervals while needed for pending source eligibility, released delivery/correction, suppression and audit obligations; afterward compact/erase under the existing owner retention/privacy class while preserving only necessary anti-replay/tombstone evidence. Do not delete an interval early and then guess historical audience, or retain stopped history forever merely for convenience. P17's 30/90-day presentation, prepared seven-day ceiling and actual Recent-copy classification remain separate from durable body-free audit. Backups, restore and erasure preserve these distinctions; restoring data cannot reactivate a Stop, leak a revoked preview or replay old notifications.

### REQ26-D15-R23 — Honest operational measurement and history

Use existing operational diagnostics for source→notification admission→local availability→optional email outcome, with distinct timestamps and safe correlation IDs. A Follow count is not readership, a read is not acknowledgment, and optional email delivery is not work completion. Do not create a new team performance dashboard or infer donor satisfaction/response effort from following.

Personal Following counts are current conversations; P17 badges are unread authorized groups; diagnostics count original activities, candidate/eligible/excluded members and independent channel outcomes. Name those units and the As of/coverage state. Failed optional fan-out, purpose-equivalent exclusions, Stop, access loss, zero-recipient releases, expiry and unknown external outcome remain diagnosable without content. Repair cannot reset an availability date, fabricate a read, remint a source event or send a new email merely to fix a metric.

### REQ26-D15-R24 — Failures, bounded scale and recovery

Following remains a committed source fact if the shared projection or email provider is unavailable. Source activity/outbox is recoverable; optional notification failure cannot lose intake, roll back assignment or hide D11/D14 required work. A lost command response reconciles its original operation; a lost P6 response reconciles the original occurrence. After release each member can suppress/fail/expire independently. Missing current authorization hides content and blocks new I/O until reproof, while a confirmed revoke ends authority under R05.

Before Live use, the generated binding must publish and boundary-test a finite recipient expansion bound and measured compiler ceiling that cover the full supported tenant envelope, including combined eligible source sets and both channels after valid merges. Do not invent a numeric product cap from a provider batch limit, silently truncate followers, split one occurrence, or newly block D10 correction merely to fit a deficient implementation. Out-of-envelope enumeration releases no partial optional set; preserve a grouped recovery condition and the underlying activity. Resolve it through the qualified shared operating envelope/whole-occurrence repair, or truthful expiry if authority/utility ends. This is not permission for routine manual reconciliation or an unlimited-scale claim. The actual supported numeric bound and latency/load measurements remain mandatory release evidence because no implemented compiler was exercised here.

Group technical failures by actionable root cause in existing owner repair surfaces, avoiding recursive follower notices about their own notification failures. The personal list/shared queue remains available under its current read contract. Do not fall back to unqualified emails, arbitrary direct database repair, guessed current recipients or a second notification service.

### REQ26-D15-R25 — Additive migration, activation and kill switches

Qualify shared P6/P17 member guards, exact source meanings, identity/current PDP, Information presentation, optional template/material class, personal settings and finite supported compiler envelope before exposing the feature. This is prerequisite owner completion, not evidence those contracts already run. Fence old Support routes, raw writes, first-agent/default preference assumptions and legacy notification emitters so they cannot bypass the new source model.

Backfill no follows from assignment, notes, authorship, watchers in another domain, email matches or existing preferences. Activate future-only, with a recorded source frontier and one active projection writer; shadow comparisons never expose duplicate notifications. Expand schema/readers before guarded writers and presentation; mixed versions reject unknown child-guard bindings. Disable new Follow admission independently from optional email, preserving existing Stop, authorized list/history and source recovery. No rollback may return to a dispatcher that ignores member guards after guarded data exists. Preserve receipts and current Stop/access state through roll-forward/restore. Do not roll back source intake or reopen older notice generations.

### REQ26-D15-R26 — Traceability and proof authority

Trace this selected answer, every R clause, event class and operational control into the accepted feature ADR/glossary, then the implementation P6/P17/26 spec/design/task/issue/test/release evidence. The new material class and generated member-guard amendment must be explicit in that owner trace; no code may silently label a follower required or assume the guard exists.

The proof matrix below is independently falsifiable and requires actual domain/user outcomes. Five isolated current-source observations support specific reuse concerns; they do not prove deployed authorization, a new follow implementation, browser quality or production capacity. Do not replace the required database/concurrency/provider/accessibility/journey proof with a count of documents or implementation-mirroring unit tests. D1–D14 remain governing; this complete D15 amendment package awaits ratification.

### REQ26-D15-C001 — The ordinary journey

Alex handles Maya's receipt question. Sam adds an internal note and wants to see Maya's response. Sam chooses **Follow conversation**. Alex keeps the assignment. Maya sees no new recipient, message or follower identity.

After the command is durably confirmed:

Keep the control compact and in the existing conversation action area. The primary reply workflow stays visually dominant. Use Core's shared base-maia/Base UI controls, semantic tokens, spacing and typography. Do not introduce a new palette, card-heavy panel, avatar strip or read-surveillance display.

The concise helper is available without hover:

> Get updates about this conversation. Assignment stays with Alex.

For Shared handling, use the current responsible inbox. Additional help describes the four update types, not generation counters or internal APIs. Start and Stop need no routine confirmation dialog; they are personal reversible choices with explicit current-state commands. Pending state remains **Following…** or **Stopping…** until the original operation is reconciled. A request timeout must not create a second toggle.

Replying, posting a note, being mentioned or receiving assignment never turns Follow on. A directed request for attention remains separate. This makes it safe for Sam to help once without an unwanted subscription.

### REQ26-D15-C002 — What updates Sam receives

Use meaningful, permission-safe labels. In the shared notification center, ordinary follower information appears in **All** under the existing policy. It does not become Needs attention simply because Sam has not read it.

| Activity                                  | Useful presentation                                               | Important limit                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ----------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Qualified human incoming message          | **New reply in a conversation you follow**                        | Preserve actual original receipt time; recovered older input is not labelled sent just now. Unqualified/quarantined material is not previewed.                                    |
| Human Support reply accepted for delivery | **Staff reply accepted for delivery**                             | Qualified P6 evidence only. Partial recipient outcomes remain truthful; delivery/read is not implied. A late confirmation distinguishes actual reply time from confirmation time. |

The in-product item may show the source-authorized topic/actor context permitted by its qualified preview contract. Recheck current access and exact source restrictions; if a safe topic cannot be shown, use the generic label. No notification includes content from an unselected merged original just to produce a richer preview. Clicking opens the relevant source contribution or outcome in current permitted handling, preserving the user's return path.

Routine assignment, coverage, Waiting, labels and CRM changes simply update the current conversation display. D14 target/reminder ticks, provider tracking, scan/retry progress and Follow/Stop themselves generate no optional follow notice. A requester reply that reopens work appears once with useful context. Actual required assignment/custody/assistance/recovery meanings use their own qualified attention contracts.

Sam's own trusted note, reply or deliberate ending does not create an optional FOLLOW notice to Sam. Send confirmation and failures remain visible through the existing sender/work flow even if Sam never follows. A background result or another colleague's input is not suppressed merely because Sam is the assignee.

One actual update may qualify through several personal reasons. The shared owner avoids a duplicate delivery only where source, purpose and channel are genuinely equivalent. Separate required actions remain independently discoverable. This is not a new topic-by-topic settings matrix or a promise that every fact must collapse into one bell item.

### REQ26-D15-C003 — Find and manage followed work

Add **Following** to the existing Support list/view filters. Start with **All statuses**, so a resolved conversation Sam still follows does not vanish unexpectedly. Existing explicit filters, saved views and normal authorized actions remain available; this is not a separate limited extension page.

Rows and counts represent current continuing conversations. A merged row can contain several original sources Sam follows; detail explains that scope when needed. **Latest followed update** uses activity relevant to Sam's selected sources, so a new unrelated merged thread does not quietly bump the row. The list is not a second unread counter or personal Open/Waiting state machine. P17's badge continues to mean unread authorized groups.

An empty state says **You aren't following any conversations yet**, with a short explanation of Follow in conversation actions. If another explicit filter hides results, explain that filter rather than reporting that no follows exist. Loading, unavailable and permission-unknown states are distinct from a true empty result.

Provide **Stop following selected** in the existing bounded selection flow for one's own selected scope. Show the actual current selected conversations; do not operate on hidden filtered rows or every possible search match without explicit review. Each result remains identifiable if current scope changes or a command fails; retry only unresolved/failed operations with their original identities. No bulk enrollment of a team or another person is introduced.

After Stop removes a row from Following, preserve the open draft and move keyboard focus predictably to an adjacent result or list control. Do not send the user to another conversation automatically. The same conversation still has its ordinary Follow action when opened from authorized search/history.

### REQ26-D15-C004 — Stop and follow again

The stop action says **Stop following conversation**, with:

> Stops optional updates for you. It does not change who handles the conversation or stop required attention.

Stop removes the selected personal interest from future optional selection. It ends unread treatment for those follow-only updates without claiming Sam read them; authorized recent history can remain. Separately qualified mentions or work attention retain their own meaning. Email already sent or in flight cannot be recalled. Unstarted email is still checked before sending. No shared status, reminder, recipient, task or CRM change accompanies Stop.

Offer **Follow again** when useful. It begins with future qualified updates and does not restore old unread items or unsent emails. Avoid a misleading Undo label that promises to restore a prior notification history. A transient toast may confirm the result, but it is not the only route back to the persistent control.

D11's **Stop following this work** stays on the delegated-work card. That action affects the conversation's interest in the delegated outcome. The full labels and placement distinguish it from Sam's personal conversation following.

### REQ26-D15-C005 — Merged and continued conversations

When Sam followed A before B was merged into it, show **Following selected threads** in the combined view. Opening following options shows only currently permitted sources and explains:

> You receive updates from the threads selected here. Merging another thread does not add it automatically.

The action **Follow all current threads** means the authorized threads shown in that panel. Its supporting copy says exactly that. It keeps already-active starts and adds only missing shown sources. No hidden original count or future merged source is implied.

If Sam follows both A and B and B is later separated by Undo, both personal interests remain with their original conversations. A later Stop on B stays stopped; Undo never restores an old follower list. New notes and replies retain their actual original affinity. A whole-work outcome can apply to several selected sources without duplicating the same qualified update.

If A's work is deliberately Continued in B under D12, A's outcome can say:

> Follow-up continues in another conversation. Open it to follow updates there.

Show **Open continued conversation** only when authorized. Following A does not automatically follow B, even when a B reply fulfills work originally transferred from A. The destination offers its own Follow action. A colleague with only access to a minimal internal-work brief sees only that brief; following is never a request for automatic full-transcript access.

### REQ26-D15-C006 — Current access and unexpected failures

After genuine access loss, remove protected following state, source previews and recent notification presentation. Do not leave a subject, donor name, hidden count or stale cached preview. A safe self-owned cleanup action can stop remaining personal intent without displaying the inaccessible source. After later regrant, Follow is a new deliberate choice; old unread history does not return.

If authorization is temporarily unavailable, show a neutral retryable unavailable state. Do not tell Sam their access was revoked or permanently stop their intent based on a failed lookup. Preserve the current draft safely and revalidate on return. Tenant/role switching clears the previous surface's visible personal data and re-queries the new scope.

When the notification pipeline is delayed, the Follow control remains the truthful source state and Following remains a source-backed finder. Shared work and required review stay discoverable. A shared service status may explain delayed updates; do not create a follower notification about every failed notification or pretend an email arrived. An ambiguous command displays its pending/recovery state until the original result is known.

### REQ26-D15-C007 — Preferences and optional email

In existing personal notification preferences, add the one qualified meaning:

This is the accepted copy, not a new Support preferences page or permission to pick another agent. The email default for this new topic is Off. Starting a Follow changes neither that setting nor any other topic. The tenant can govern the optional email step through P17; show **Email disabled by your organization** or **Email unavailable** when relevant, without disabling useful in-product following or offering a sender-configuration shortcut.

Channel enablement applies to future source activity. Turning email on after an event cannot email that old event, even if its first notification admission was delayed. Off/on cycles do not revive earlier email eligibility. Turning email Off does not stop follows, in-product information or independently required attention. Reading one channel is not assumed to complete the other.

Optional email usefulness ends at seven days from first qualified source availability, with every earlier applicable stop. A late prepared artifact cannot renew that period. In-product unread/history is also limited by the source's original 30/90-day cutoffs as well as P17's own limits. This is background correctness, not a countdown to display to ordinary users. Old newly projected history is not shown as freshly unread; actual receipt/availability times remain honest.

### REQ26-D15-C008 — Email Studio starter: Followed conversation update

Add this narrowly governed source meaning to P17's catalog and the canonical Email Studio starters before enabling email. Use the existing staff/service-compatible layout and qualified staff-operation sender/reply identity. The new prepared-material class is **prepared.optional_support_follow_update_7d@1**; it does not broaden the old class or turn information into required action.

**Protected default content:**

The HTML and plain-text versions express the same short pointer. The notification intentionally contains no note excerpt, transcript, attachment, financial record, missionary location, requester email or sensitive subject. The in-product destination supplies currently permitted context after authentication. The default can remain generic across E1–E4 so delayed or changed shared status is not falsely described as current work completion in delivered email.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Permitted fact                | Authority and use                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Tenant display name / brand   | Existing qualified tenant message profile; escaped text and approved presentation only.                                                |
| View conversation destination | Server-issued typed recipient/source destination, resolved against current access/root on opening; URL possession grants no authority. |
| Manage following destination  | Authenticated personal current-scope settings/action surface. GET never executes Stop.                                                 |
| Fixed optional-help wording   | Protected purpose-compatible text; does not add a public promise or claim successful delivery/read.                                    |

No CRM merge field, free-form source body, automatic quote, all-followers audience, arbitrary redirect or caller-selected sender is in the default contract. Template publication, translation, fallback and variable validation reuse P17.

The shared P6 occurrence creates in-product availability independently from the optional email sibling. Resend dispatch uses the existing immutable submission, verified sender identity, provider correlation and reconciliation. A staff notification is not inserted into the requester thread or counted as a donor interaction, human Support reply or resolved request. Replying to its email does not publish an internal note or send a requester response; staff use the protected Support destination.

### REQ26-D15-C009 — Accessibility and verification

Use Base UI command/menu semantics for the sketches above. A control whose action label changes must not also expose misleading aria-pressed semantics; a true pressed toggle requires a stable label. Verify visible focus, Tab/Shift+Tab, Enter/Space, arrow/Escape menu behavior, scope-panel focus containment/return and polite async result messages. All explanations and stops must work without hover.

At 320 CSS pixels and 200% zoom, maintain useful labels and actions without mandatory horizontal tables. Support RTL, long international names and locale/timezone-specific dates. Keep touch hit areas from the shared system, preserve its reduced-motion behavior, and avoid notification sounds or motion that the existing presentation contract does not authorize.

Verify normal/partial following, currently resolved work, Follow again, bulk Stop, access loss/outage, missing identity/channel, CRM return, merge/Undo/continuation, notification click and offline/reconnect. Exercise exact role/source permissions and current data, not just screenshots or mocked success. D15-P01–P54 are mandatory release proof; none is claimed executed by this blueprint.\*\*
